home.directionsText: We start with programming. New fields will appear here as their programmes are ready.
home.soonText: Want to hear first? Subscribe to our news.

steps.d: Create an account and pick a course and group.
A 15–20 minute video call and a short practical task.
Online via Idram or card, monthly or in full. The first lesson is a trial.
After the final project you receive a numbered certificate that can be verified on this site.
